@@ -1,8 +1,10 @@
 import pytest
+from luqum.tree import Group, Not, OrOperation, SearchField, Word
 from openlibrary.solr.query_utils import (
     EmptyTreeError,
     luqum_parser,
     luqum_remove_child,
+    luqum_replace_child,
     luqum_traverse,
 )
 
@@ -32,6 +34,47 @@ def test_luqum_remove_child(query: str, to_rem: str, expected: str):
     assert fn(query, to_rem) == expected
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('parent_type', [OrOperation, Group, Not])
+def test_luqum_replace_child(parent_type):
+    old_child = Word('old')
+    other_child = Word('other')
+    new_child = Word('new')
+    parent = (
+        parent_type(old_child, other_child)
+        if parent_type is OrOperation
+        else parent_type(old_child)
+    )
+    children_type = type(parent.children)
+
+    luqum_replace_child(parent, old_child, new_child)
+
+    assert type(parent.children) is children_type
+    assert tuple(parent.children) == (
+        (new_child, other_child) if parent_type is OrOperation else (new_child,)
+    )
+
+
+def test_luqum_replace_child_matches_equal_children_and_leaves_absent_unchanged():
+    old_child = Word('old')
+    other_child = Word('other')
+    parent = OrOperation(old_child, other_child, Word('old'))
+    new_child = Word('new')
+
+    luqum_replace_child(parent, old_child, new_child)
+    assert parent.children == (new_child, other_child, new_child)
+
+    children = parent.children
+    luqum_replace_child(parent, Word('absent'), Word('unused'))
+    assert parent.children == children
+
+
+def test_luqum_replace_child_unsupported_parent():
+    parent = SearchField('title', Word('old'))
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='^Not supported for generic class Item$'):
+        luqum_replace_child(parent, parent.children[0], Word('new'))
+
+
 def test_luqum_parser():
     def fn(query: str) -> str:
         return str(luqum_parser(query))
